code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis and basophilia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), and prolonged INR. These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or severe infection, and significant respiratory compromise. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
